title: Height-Balanced Token-Bucket Invariants for PHP-Based Notification Queues with Exponential Backoff and Rate Limiting
topic: Height-Balanced Token-Bucket Invariants for PHP-Based Notification Queues with Exponential Backoff and Rate Limiting

abstract:
We present a PHP-based notification engine that couples a token-bucket rate limiter, exponential back-off retry policy, and a height-balanced binary search tree for queue ordering. The design preserves a strict height-balanced invariant and key-ordered invariant, guaranteeing $O(\log N)$ complexity for enqueue, dequeue, and retry scheduling. We formalize state transitions for notification objects, including attempt counters and next-attempt timestamps, and prove that the queue remains height-balanced after each operation. Static analysis of the source yields 253 SLOC and 46 function blocks, with an AST depth of 12. No empirical timing data is reported; all claims are supported by formal proofs and static bounds.
